title: arisarum vulgare subsp. clusii
intro: Arisarum vulgare subsp. clusii, commonly known as the Clusius's Arum, is a plant species that belongs to the Arum family (Araceae). This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include being used to treat various health conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and skin issues, due to its anti-inflammatory and antibacterial properties. The therapeutic actions of Arisarum vulgare subsp. clusii include being a diaphoretic, which helps to induce sweating, and an anti-inflammatory agent, which reduces swelling and pain. Bioactive constituents of the plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
